_doc: The interior side of this room's door, for the coordinator wiring it to the town.  tools/scenegraph_derive.mjs needs nothing from this file — it reads walk_pad_door out of scene.glb by name.  This is the human-readable statement of the same fact, plus the one thing the derive cannot check: which wall of the real building the door is in.

frames.runtime: (x, z, -y) — the glTF y-up export play3d.html reads

facingIntoRoom.note: the direction a player is looking the moment they arrive on walk_pad_door — set spawnYaw from this if the runtime ever stops leaving it null

townSide: The bakery is at map (24.5, 21.5), square-plaza at (32, 22): its face is EAST, onto the square, and the map's own note is 'warm window on the square'. In the interior's frame the square is -x: the door AND the serving window are both in that wall, the window south of the door.
otherPads: walk_pad_oven (up two steps, on the bakehouse platform)
